scenarios.name: new-sketch-01 Create a sketch on a named origin plane

scenario_steps.name: Part2 has Sketch1 and the Origin browser is expanded
the user invoke Start 2D Sketch and choose XZ Plane
Sketch2 is added in the Sketch editing environment
the ViewCube reads TOP
the empty sketch status reads Fully Constrained

scenarios.name: new-sketch-02 Cancel before selecting a plane

scenario_steps.name: Part2 has only Sketch1
the user invoke Start 2D Sketch and press Escape before choosing a plane
the reference-plane previews disappear
the browser still contains only Sketch1

scenarios.name: new-sketch-03 Escape after accepting the support plane

scenario_steps.name: selecting XZ Plane has created empty Sketch2
the user press Escape
Sketch2 remains active in the Sketch editing environment
creation is not rolled back

scenarios.name: new-sketch-04 Creation and finishing have distinct history transactions

scenario_steps.name: the user have created empty Sketch2 and chosen Finish Sketch
the user press Ctrl+Z once
Sketch2 remains and its editing environment returns
the user press Ctrl+Z again
Sketch2 disappears from the model browser
the user press Ctrl+Y twice in sequence
creation and Finish Sketch are restored in order

scenarios.name: new-sketch-05 Start with a preselected support plane

scenario_steps.name: the model browser exposes YZ Plane
the user select YZ Plane before invoking Start 2D Sketch
Sketch3 is created without another support-selection click
the ViewCube reads RIGHT
the empty sketch status reads Fully Constrained

scenarios.name: new-sketch-07 Create an empty sketch on a planar solid face

scenario_steps.name: isolated Part3 contains a 10 mm rectangular extrusion
the user invoke Start 2D Sketch and select its broad planar face
Sketch2 is added in the Sketch editing environment
FRONT view and empty Fully Constrained status are displayed
the user choose Finish Sketch
Sketch2 is retained beside Extrusion1

scenarios.name: new-sketch-08 Create a sketch on a non-origin work plane

scenario_steps.name: Work Plane1 was created 5 mm offset from the planar face
the user preselect Work Plane1 and invoke Start 2D Sketch
empty Sketch3 is created without another support click
Finish Sketch retains Sketch3 and Work Plane1

scenarios.name: new-sketch-09 Observe each automatic startup plane and restore the baseline

scenario_steps.name: No new sketch is the starting preference
the user accept each automatic startup plane in turn
the user create a fresh metric part document after each change
x-y creates Part4 Sketch1 in FRONT view
y-z creates Part5 Sketch1 in RIGHT view
x-z creates Part6 Sketch1 in TOP orientation
no separate Start 2D Sketch action is needed in those routes
No new sketch is restored accepted and verified

scenarios.name: new-sketch-10 Compare automatic normal view on creation and edit

scenario_steps.name: Part6 is in an oblique Home View
the user disable Part Look at sketch plane and create a sketch on YZ Plane
Sketch2 is created and the oblique view remains
the user finish Sketch2 and restore Part Look at sketch plane
the user choose Edit Sketch on that same Sketch2
its editing environment opens in RIGHT view

scenarios.name: new-sketch-06 Save close and reopen an accumulated sketch document

scenario_steps.name: Part1 contains an existing sketch with geometry
the user finish Sketch3 and save Part1
the user close the document using its document Close button
the MCAD Software Home is shown without a save prompt
the user open Part1 from Documents using the file picker
the saved model browser and geometry load
the user choose Edit Sketch on Sketch3
the Sketch ribbon and editable geometry are available
the rectangular and circular pattern entries remain in Sketch3
